results.evidence: Retry confirmed only that the Wellington trailhead (2.8 mi up the Old Stevens Pass Highway, via FS road 050) needs a Northwest Forest or America the Beautiful pass; no source addresses the unofficial pullout ~1.4 mi from US-2 that serves the crag, and the crag's own route-database page says nothing about passes. access.passRequired 'Recreation pass' vs access.notes/parking_pass 'no fee site' stays open.

Still only one external source for the route's own height (50 ft / 15 m, matching length_m); the crag-wide 'about 85 ft or less' is repeated on an aggregator page that mirrors the same database. descent_text's 85-ft rappel looks like the crag cap reused, but a second independent per-route height was not found. Suggested fix unchanged: drop the 85-ft figure from descent_text.

Jackson Wilderness boundary lies within 400 m of it, and the Wild Sky Wilderness lies more than 5 km away (along the North Fork Skykomish/Beckler). So the Wild Sky wording is wrong, but because the crag sits right at the Henry M. Jackson boundary and the coordinate's precision is uncertain, the correct permit statement cannot be written with confidence.
